_comment: FLEET-STANDARD RENOVATE CONFIG. Copy verbatim to <app>/renovate.json (repo root) — scaffold/apply.sh does this. Pairs with the runner template .forgejo/workflows/renovate.yml (also in this bundle). Runs as a scheduled Actions workflow rather than a k8s CronJob so it needs no cluster access. This is a CONSERVATIVE preset for a solo operator: weekly digest (not continuous), minor/patch grouped into one PR per manager, majors always separate AND gated behind an explicit dependency-dashboard checkbox, automerge OFF everywhere, CVE fixes bypass the schedule. No app-specific edits should be needed for a plain composer+npm Laravel/Inertia app.
_comment_managers: Explicitly scoped to the two managers this fleet actually has (Laravel/composer.json, Vite+React/package.json). Without this, Renovate's manager autodetection would also try to bump image tags inside .forgejo/workflows/*.yml (postgres, aquasec/trivy, git.example.com:3000/your-org/ci-php) — those are a deliberate, hand-ratcheted pin (see a documented tradeoff / forgejo-ci.md), not something a bot should touch.
_comment_schedule: A weekly digest window, not continuous updates — a solo operator reviews once a week, not on every upstream release. This is the OUTER bound shared by every app; the actual day/minute each app's workflow fires is staggered in .forgejo/workflows/renovate.yml's cron so your apps don't all land PRs (and trigger CI) on the shared Forgejo runner at the same moment. vulnerabilityAlerts below ignores this window entirely — a disclosed CVE never waits for Monday.
_comment_limits: Caps how many PRs one Renovate run can open — the shared Forgejo runner has capacity 6 (two replicas x 3, see forgejo-ci.md); this keeps one app's weekly sweep from filling the whole queue before anything else can run.
_comment_automerge: OFF everywhere, deliberately, and not just 'conservative by default' — merging to main on this fleet is not inert. It triggers a Forgejo Actions build -> registry push -> k8s tag bump -> ArgoCD sync (see argocd-deploy-flow). An auto-merged dependency bump is an auto-DEPLOY to production with no human in the loop. You review and merge every Renovate PR by hand, exactly like every other PR.

schedule: before 5am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Group every minor/patch/pin/digest update per manager into ONE PR instead of one-PR-per-package — the single biggest noise reduction for a solo reviewer.

Majors are NEVER grouped and NEVER opened automatically. fleet-app-specification pins the framework majors deliberately (React 19 / Laravel 13 / TS 6 / Vite 8 / Tailwind 4 / Inertia v3) — a major bump is your decision. This just surfaces it as a checkbox on the dependency-dashboard issue; ticking it is how you ask Renovate to open the PR.
